title: Add missing federal source-family routes
objective: HRSA AHRF, NPPES, SAMHSA, T-MSIS/TAF and SVI have supported product identities and access routes.
outcome: Five frozen federal families have evidence-backed intake dispositions. Every locator is publisher-supported. TAF restricted research files are not confused with public Medicaid summary products, and adding a route never asserts access to restricted TAF data. Each family has a literal configuration and fixture. An unsupported protocol produces a specific extension task rather than a custom unbounded scraper. Original NPPES/AHRF/SAMHSA/SVI questions identify the intended family and exact restrictions remain visible. Catalog membership is not invented. Frozen packages/retrieval/fixtures/named-source-registry.v1.0.0.json is reused read-only unless a staged copy is required. Last-good generation live-2026-09-03-85b50522b420 is unchanged.

commits.subject: Capture exact publisher intake records

commits.verification: Each family has a literal configuration and fixture; an unsupported protocol produces a specific extension task rather than a custom unbounded scraper.
